english.title: Channel tunnel - make false statement to obtain identity document
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) for the purpose of, or in connection with, an application made by

(A)_[you]_
(B)_[another]_

for the issue of an identity document to which article 30(1) of the Channel Tunnel (Security) Order 1994 applied, made to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..),

(C)_[the concessionaire,]_
(D)_[the owner of a Channel Tunnel train,]_
(E)_[the operator of a Channel Tunnel train,]_
(F)_[the train manager of a Channel Tunnel train,]_
(G)_[a person permitted to have access to a restricted zone,]_
(H)_[a security approved channel tunnel freight forwarder,]_
(I)_[a constable,]_

a statement which you knew to be false in a material particular or recklessly made to the said **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) a statement which was false in a material particular in that **(..SPECIFY FALSIFICATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to article 30(1)(a) and (5) of the Channel Tunnel (Security) Order 1994.
